answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral, so coordinated equivocation by k correlated identities incurs penalties scaling as O(k²), rather than linearly. Once detected, an additional exponential multiplier compounds capital loss across the swarm’s linked escrows, while asymmetric depreciation reduces residual value and deters recovery. A knoll, willow, or falcon may label an account, but none can defeat correlation evidence, attribution, and collective slashing.
